description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for filtering, sorting, and formatting references (refs) in a version control system, likely Git. It includes definitions for ref filtering options, ref sorting, ref formatting, and related operations.

methods.name: ref_kind_from_refname
methods.description: Determines the kind of reference from its name.

methods.name: filter_refs
methods.description: Filters a set of references based on provided filter criteria.

methods.name: filter_and_format_refs
methods.description: Filters references and outputs them in a specified format.

methods.name: ref_array_clear
methods.description: Clears memory allocated for a ref_array.

methods.name: verify_ref_format
methods.description: Verifies and finalizes a ref_format structure.

methods.name: ref_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts a ref_array according to specified criteria.

methods.name: ref_sorting_set_sort_flags_all
methods.description: Sets sorting flags for all elements in a ref_sorting list.

methods.name: format_ref_array_item
methods.description: Formats a ref_array_item into a string buffer.

methods.name: ref_sorting_options
methods.description: Creates ref_sorting from a list of sort options.

methods.name: get_head_description
methods.description: Returns a description of the current HEAD.

methods.name: print_formatted_ref_array
methods.description: Prints references in a specified format.

methods.name: pretty_print_ref
methods.description: Prints a single reference in a human-readable format.

methods.name: ref_array_push
methods.description: Adds a reference to a ref_array.

methods.name: filter_is_base
methods.description: Determines if refs are bases for other refs.

methods.name: ref_filter_clear
methods.description: Clears resources in a ref_filter structure.
